claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament will be played April 6–12, 2026, at Augusta National Golf Club.
The 2026 Masters Tournament is the 90th edition of the tournament.
The 2026 Masters Tournament dates are Monday, April 6 – Sunday, April 12, 2026.
The 2026 Masters Tournament location is Augusta National Golf Club, Augusta, Georgia.
The approximate 2026 Masters Tournament schedule includes practice rounds April 6-8.
The approximate 2026 Masters Tournament schedule includes Par-3 Contest April 8.
The approximate 2026 Masters Tournament schedule includes tournament rounds 1–4 April 9-12.
The Masters tickets application process is closed.
All 2026 Masters tickets are already allocated.
Tiger Woods is reportedly keeping the 2026 Masters in play following recovery from back surgery.
Top early contenders and odds for the 2026 Masters include Scottie Scheffler (+400).
Top early contenders and odds for the 2026 Masters include Rory McIlroy (+900).
Top early contenders and odds for the 2026 Masters include Bryson DeChambeau (+1200).
